dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 18, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Pirates Take Down Guardians in Opener, Dodgers Roll Over Yankees**

The Pittsburgh Pirates got off to a strong start, defeating the Cleveland Guardians 7-1 behind Jared Jones' dominant performance. Jones tossed 5.0 innings, striking out 9 and allowing just 1 earned run. Jacob Gonzalez led the Pirates' offense, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs. Bryan Reynolds also had a big game, scoring the go-ahead run on a sacrifice fly in the key game detail.

In other action, the Chicago Cubs took down the Minnesota Twins 6-2, with Kody Clemens hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs. Meanwhile, the Los Angeles Dodgers rolled over the New York Yankees 8-2, with Yoshinobu Yamamoto tossing a complete-game shutout and striking out 7.

The Toronto Blue Jays edged out the Chicago White Sox 1-0, with Shane Bieber throwing 6.0 shutout innings and striking out 6.
